shops.description: LSS Shop by lee-sungsoo: Listed price, Signed receipt, Single reply. These equal this round's lowest deal prices in the whole market. Listed prices: lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260. Handmade solid brass and hardwood (no plating, no veneer), 2-year warranty. Your deal counts: the receipt is signed with lee-sungsoo's registered key, shows exactly the agreed price and names the item you ordered. Our prices are at or below this round's average deal price for every item. Offer the listed price and our first reply is the signed receipt: one message, no haggling needed. LSS stamp card: every purchase comes with an LSS stamp code; send 4 different unused codes and that piece is at our lowest price (lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260). Every 100th customer gets our lowest price as a welcome. LSS Shop is lee-sungsoo's shop in this market, and LSS are the owner's initials. Premium furniture workshop: desk lamps in genuine solid brass (no plating), chairs and bookshelves in solid hardwood (no veneer), each made by hand.
